elimination.campus_noodle_cellar: Noodles only. Liam ruled noodles out and the review says 'don't come in craving a burger'.
elimination.campus_brisket_box: Fast and cheap, but no vegetarian option. Even the fries are cooked in beef fat, so Mina can't eat anything there.
elimination.campus_patty_parlor: Has a veggie patty, but it's slow table service with no quick_bite tag. The review says 'Don't come here on a short break'.
elimination.campus_bun_stop: Burgers, $, quick_bite, vegan_options, and a black bean patty mentioned in the reviews. Meets every constraint.

notes: Fair and solvable. Mina's vegetarian diet is never stated outright. It comes from the 'just get fries' pattern plus 'veggie patty', which is a good stripped-clue hint but still fairly easy to read. Each wrong burger venue fails on exactly one axis (diet or speed), so the elimination is clean. Brisket Box's beef-fat fries review is a nice touch: it shuts down the 'she can just get fries' fallback. Nothing contradictory. There is no explicit budget line, which is fine because every venue is $. Mild concern: the dietary constraint rests on the 'veggie patty' line and a player might read it as a preference rather than a strict diet. Either reading still leads to Bun Stop, though.
